# Sync README: dashboard link, block counts, target packaging

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

Pass over the README to fix several spots that had drifted from the
current code.

- Fix the broken `#dashboard` anchor; point at the real GitHub Pages
  URL.
- Correct demo block counts in the intro and Status section: every
  `*-demo-tiny.yml` uses the 5000 default, every `*-demo-full.yml`
  overrides to 500. The README claimed "5 000 each."
- Add `num_blocks: 500` to the `myteam-demo-full.yml` template so a new
  team copying it doesn't inherit the 5000 default.
- Make standard target packaging
  ([spec](https://github.com/davxy/jam-conformance/tree/main/fuzz-proto#standard-target-packaging))
  the canonical onboarding path: rewrite step 1 to lead with
  "configure via env vars, do not set `docker_cmd`," remove
  `docker_cmd` examples from all three workflow templates, and mark
  `docker_cmd` as a legacy compat shim in the workflow inputs
  reference.
- Backfill missing items in the Project structure listing: `ci.yml`,
  `deploy-dashboard.yml`, `scripts/`, `agents.md`, `tests/config.test.ts`,
  and the `dashboard/` submodule.

## Test plan

- [ ] Skim rendered README on the PR page; verify the dashboard link,
      block-count text, and onboarding templates read correctly.
- [ ] Confirm no team workflow files were touched (README-only change).
